item.title: Was that real racing or just Overtake Mode? Lack of data leaves us in the dark | Formula 1
item.description: Formula 1's new cars appeared to race well in the first race of the season. But it's impossible to say how influential Overtake Mode was.

item.title: “Ferrari have the best car, their cornering speeds are unbelievable” – Norris | Formula 1
item.description: Mercedes may have finished first and second in qualifying and the grand prix in Melbourne but Lando Norris believes Ferrari have a stronger chassis.

item.title: New Formula 1 car was “super-frustrating” to drive in first race – Verstappen | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen's race engineer told him drivers ahead were "elated with this whole thing" after he complained about Formula 1's new cars.

item.title: Ferrari’s gamble not to pit in Virtual Safety Car period was right call – Leclerc | Formula 1
item.description: Charles Leclerc said Ferrari made a tactical decision not to pit during the first Virtual Safety Car because they expected more would occur.

item.title: F1 has become like Mario Kart with new rules, say Verstappen and Leclerc | Formula 1
item.description: Two of Formula 1's top drivers said the racing in the first race of the new season reminded them of Mario Kart.

item.title: First-lap near-miss with Lawson was “scary moment” for Colapinto | Formula 1
item.description: Franco Colapinto said he "almost went straight into the back of" Liam Lawson when the Racing Bulls driver made a poor start.

item.title: Leclerc went from fourth to first at start despite ‘very low battery’ | Formula 1
item.description: Charles Leclerc said he "thought I would end up ninth" instead of first as he started more slowly than he expected.

item.title: “It’s a big advantage to be second”: Russell and Leclerc’s radio from their lead battle | Formula 1
item.description: Charles Russell and George Russell's radio messages from their fight for the lead in Melbourne show the influence of Formula 1's new power units.

item.title: Verstappen accused Lindblad of “brake-checking” him in the pit lane | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen accused Racing Bulls' new driver Arvid Lindblad of "brake checking" him in the pit lane during the Australian Grand Prix.

item.title: Round-up: F1’s new rules risk a car ‘going over the fence’ warns Norris, and more | RaceFans Round-up
item.description: Also in Monday's edition of the RaceFans round-up, Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur claims F1's new rules have succeeded.
